chunks: Did I not commit you, O children of Adam, not to worship Satan who is your acknowledged foe,

key_terms.أَعْهَدْ: To make a covenant or commit solemnly

ai.seo_question: What is the covenant God made with humanity regarding Satan in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Covenant of Alast, emphasizing that the recognition of God's lordship and Satan's enmity is innate (fitrah) to every human soul. It establishes the theological foundation for monotheism by defining the primary spiritual struggle as resisting the clear deception of Satan, thereby clarifying the nature of true servitude to Allah.
